name: academic-enterprise-information-systems
description: Specializes in Enterprise Information Systems and IT Governance building on Management Information Systems (Laudon, Laudon) and Business Process Management (Dumas et al.). Covers Business Process Modeling (BPMN 2.0), Integrated Management Systems (ERP, CRM, SCM), Governance and Strategic Alignment (ITIL 4, COBIT 2019), Business Intelligence (BI), Process Mining, and Operational Risk Management.
